name: Khasi Mandarin Orange

name: Assam Mandarin
description: High aroma, intense volatile rind oils, and balanced acidity 2 . | Bulk commercial juice concentrate and export markets 11 .

name: Kachai Lemon
description: Locally known as Kachai Champra ; highest concentration of ascorbic acid globally 20 . | Fresh culinary use, pickling, and freeze-dried juice powder processing 20 .

name: Naga Sweet Orange
description: Low acidity, high sweetness, and organically cultivated in hilly terrains 21 . | Fresh retail fruit and premium organic segments 22 .

name: Galgal (Citrus pseudolimon)
description: Large, highly acidic fruits rich in pectin and medicinal citric acid 2 . | Heavy pickling, citrus vinegar, and industrial citric acid extraction.

description: Extremely large fruit with pink or white segment sacs; high in potassium, copper, and vitamin C 23 . | Fresh salads, commercial juice blending, and high-pectin marmalades 23 .

name: Kaffir Lime
description: Highly aromatic, wrinkled green rind and bi-lobed leaves rich in citronellal. | Essential oil extraction and fresh culinary use in Southeast Asian cuisines.

name: Citron
description: Thick, fleshy rind; rich in volatile essential oils and medicinal properties 2 . | Candied peel processing, medicinal extracts, and essential oils.

name: Kiwi
description: High ascorbic acid (vitamin C) and actinidin enzyme content; organic mountain crop. | Premium fresh retail, dehydrated kiwi slices, and fruit pulp.

name: Avocado
description: Rich in monounsaturated fatty acids (oleic acid) and vitamin E; buttery texture. | Premium fresh retail and cosmetic-grade cold-pressed oil extraction.

name: Dragon Fruit
description: High antioxidant content (betalains); emerging climate-resilient crop. | Fresh wellness retail and natural organic food colouring.

name: Passion Fruit
description: Intense tropical aroma, high acidity, and rich yellow pulp; processing grade 26 . | High-value juice concentrate, squashes, and RTS beverages 26 .

name: Persimmon
description: Rare high-altitude orange fruit; rich in tannins and soluble dietary fibres. | Premium fresh dessert fruit and dehydrated sweet slices.

name: Plum

name: Peach
description: Soft-fleshed mountain crop; high water content and delicate aroma. | Premium fresh retail and processed canned halves in syrup.

name: Pear
description: Crispy temperate crop; high stone-cell density and high dietary fibre. | Fresh retail, dehydrated fruit leather, and perry (pear cider).

name: Banana

description: High yield; rich in papain enzyme and dietary fiber. | Green papaya latex extraction, candy ( tutti-frutti ), and pulp.

name: Mango
description: Local high-aroma varieties suited for humid subtropical zones 2 . | Fresh local retail, green mango pickling, and pulp concentrate.

name: Jackfruit

name: Guava
description: High vitamin C and pectin content; pink and white pulp varieties. | Fresh retail, high-viscosity guava jelly, and RTS beverages.

name: Custard Apple
description: Sweet, creamy pulp with high caloric density and calcium levels. | Fresh local markets and premium ice-cream pulp base.

description: High-altitude, sour forest fruit; high pectin and polyphenol content. | Dried wild apple slices, herbal teas, and traditional medicines 4 .

description: Small, gritty green fruits; astringent and highly fibrous landrace. | Traditional medicine, vinegar production, and wild cider brewing.

name: Bhut Jolokia
description: High heat index; up to 1,000,000 Scoville Heat Units (SHU) 22 .

description: Small, intensely pungent chillies; rich in vitamins 26 .

description: Low fiber in Aizol ; high oleoresin oil recovery ( Gingerin ) 48 .

description: Curcumin content of 7% to 12%; bright golden-yellow hue 17 .

description: Bold capsules with a strong smoky, camphoraceous aroma 53 .

description: Sourced around Shillong; high essential oil content 51 .

description: Known as Kenye ; rich in alpha-linolenic acid (omega-3) and proteins.

name: Coriander
description: High-aroma coriander varieties grown in moist valley soils 13 .
